articles.summary: Epsilon’s academic search capability is great for finding scientifically accurate information. But to properly conduct a detailed literature review, it’s helpful to have a place to store all the papers that you encounter during your search in a centralized and organized place.
articles.title: Epsilon Libraries: Save and Analyze Your Favorite Papers

articles.summary: Epsilon now lets you refine summaries for a given query. After you make a search, you can star papers that you think are the most relevant and regenerate the answer using only the selected papers.
articles.title: Feature Release: Refine Summaries Using Selected Papers
